about:
IEG Plastics was founded in 2004 in Bellefontaine, Ohio. The company supplies plastic parts and assemblies to the automotive and consumer goods sectors.

The shop provides plastic injection molding, mold building, and product design services under one roof. Its capabilities include tight-tolerance molding to ±0.02 mm, insert and overmolding, robotics, sonic welding, and assembly. The facility runs RJG process control and operates an environmentally controlled metrology lab equipped with a Brown & Sharpe CMM, Micro-VU Vertex 311HC, Zeiss 3D light scanner, and Tenney environmental chamber. Mold building capacity reaches 20,000 lb tools, supported by a U.S.-based repair and engineering-change shop.

Primary markets are automotive safety components, precision consumer goods, and sporting goods. The company cites experience with high-volume, tight-tolerance parts for automotive safety devices and consumer products.

IEG Plastics emphasizes turnkey solutions that combine design, tooling, and production to reduce supply-chain complexity. Its quality system follows ISO 9001:2015 with APQP and PPAP expertise, and the firm highlights short lead times, in-house mold support, and value-added assembly as differentiators.
